generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 0, unique per table; never NULL; never duplicated or tied.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from parent key pool with replacement; NULL share follows the compact DB share for that column (overrides the generic 5-30% band); reserve at least one parent key excluded from the child pool so parent_rows_without_children holds by construction.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer within the column's declared range; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real within the column's declared range rounded to 3 decimals; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Uniform choice from the explicit enum pool; case and near-duplicate variants of listed equality literals are added to the pool only when the column's per_column_exceptions say so.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Short alphanumeric string; near-variants of listed equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Uniform datetime within the table's observed range, format '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.0'; include boundary dates at listed literals and one day on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, NULL share follows the compact DB share for that column; at least one NULL row per nullable column; planted NULLs are never replaced.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_distinct: For DISTINCT-count columns that are not primary keys, 20-50% duplicate values.
generic_sampling_rules.ties_order_limit: For ORDER/LIMIT columns that are not primary keys, plant ties at the listed rank (e.g. rank 1 for DESC).
generic_sampling_rules.domain_tuple_shape: Numeric domains are passed to samplers as 2-tuples (lo, hi); the integer/decimal flag is carried separately, never as a third tuple element.
